citation.authors: Rahbari-Oskoui FF, Abramson JL, Bruckman AM, Chapman AB et al

cited_by.title: Melatonin for sleep: what it does, dose and rules by country

record.population: Self-defined African American patients with essential hypertension, urban academic medical centre, United States
record.design: Randomised, placebo-controlled crossover pilot: 24 mg sustained-release melatonin at night against placebo, 4 weeks each
record.finding: Night-time and daytime blood pressure on 24-hour monitoring did not differ between melatonin and placebo. The authors note this contrasts with studies in other populations.
record.note: A trial in Black participants, but its outcome was blood pressure, with sleep unmeasured, at a dose far above the usual one. The registry lists a second 8 mg study (NCT01114360, 37 people, results posted) that I did not read.
